text: Explain the role of information systems in business functions

text: List the components of a decision support system
subject: Management Information Systems
correctAnswer: Database model base and user interface.

text: Explain the features of an executive information system
subject: Management Information Systems
correctAnswer: An EIS provides summarised graphical and easy to use access to key performance indicators and drill down capability for senior executives.

subject: Management Information Systems
explanation: A data warehouse consolidates historical data for reporting and analysis.

text: Distinguish between data and information
subject: Management Information Systems
correctAnswer: Data are raw unprocessed facts while information is data that has been processed into a meaningful useful form.
explanation: Processing transforms data into information.

text: Explain the advantages of database management systems
subject: Management Information Systems
correctAnswer: A DBMS reduces data redundancy ensures consistency security and integrity and allows easy sharing and retrieval of data across users.

text: Protecting information from unauthorised access is information security
subject: Management Information Systems
explanation: Information security protects confidentiality integrity and availability.

text: List the phases of the system development life cycle
subject: Management Information Systems
correctAnswer: Feasibility analysis design development testing implementation and maintenance.
explanation: These phases take a system from idea to operation.

text: Explain the importance of information system security
subject: Management Information Systems
correctAnswer: Security protects data from loss theft and unauthorised access ensuring confidentiality integrity and availability and maintaining trust and legal compliance.

subject: Management Information Systems
explanation: AI gives systems the ability to learn and reason like humans.

text: List the advantages of e commerce
subject: Management Information Systems

text: Explain the benefits and challenges of ERP systems
subject: Management Information Systems

text: The study of whether a proposed system is technically and economically possible is
subject: Management Information Systems

text: Explain the impact of information technology on organisations
subject: Management Information Systems
correctAnswer: IT flattens structures speeds communication enables new business models and improves decision making while demanding new skills and security.

subject: Management Information Systems
correctAnswer: The retailer should implement an ERP system to integrate the three systems into one database giving a single accurate view of inventory.

text: Read the case: A manager must decide whether to open a new store but data is scattered in reports. Suggest a system to help analyse the decision
subject: Management Information Systems
correctAnswer: A decision support system would let the manager model sales and costs under different scenarios to compare the options before deciding.
explanation: Apply DSS modelling to support the what if analysis.

text: Explain the types of e commerce
subject: Management Information Systems
correctAnswer: E commerce includes business to consumer business to business consumer to consumer and consumer to business transactions each linking different parties.

text: Explain the role of MIS in decision making
subject: Management Information Systems
correctAnswer: MIS provides accurate timely and relevant information that reduces uncertainty and supports structured semi structured and strategic decisions across management levels.
explanation: Link information provision to better decisions.

text: List the threats to information systems
subject: Management Information Systems
correctAnswer: Hacking viruses malware insider misuse and natural disasters.
explanation: These threats compromise data and system availability.

text: Explain the measures for securing information systems
subject: Management Information Systems
correctAnswer: Security measures include access control passwords encryption firewalls backups and antivirus software combined with policies and user training.
explanation: Cover technical and administrative safeguards.

text: The data that describes other data is called metadata
subject: Management Information Systems
explanation: Metadata is data about data describing its structure and meaning.

text: Explain the evolution of MIS
subject: Management Information Systems
correctAnswer: MIS evolved from transaction processing through management reporting and decision support to enterprise and strategic systems integrated by the internet.
explanation: Trace the stages from TPS to modern integrated systems.

text: The process of extracting useful patterns from large data sets is data

text: Explain the importance of data quality in information systems
subject: Management Information Systems
correctAnswer: Poor data quality leads to wrong decisions so accuracy completeness timeliness and consistency of data are essential for reliable information and systems.
explanation: Link data quality to decision reliability.

text: Cloud computing delivers computing services over the internet on demand
subject: Management Information Systems
explanation: Cloud computing provides on demand internet based computing resources.

text: Explain the benefits of cloud computing for business
subject: Management Information Systems
correctAnswer: Cloud computing reduces capital cost offers scalability and flexibility and enables remote access and collaboration with pay per use pricing.
explanation: Cover cost scalability and accessibility benefits.

text: Explain the limitations of management information systems
subject: Management Information Systems
